confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors rest on aggregator, blog and undated figures, mostly in EUR, converted at about 1.12 USD per EUR (an assumption derived from a third-party AUD cross rate). Prices vary sharply between residential bacari and the San Marco tourist core. Cocktail and wine values are bounded estimates from bar-price ranges, with the beer figure as a reference point. Hostel and hotel anchors are holistic model estimates for July with no live listings or accommodation searches. The FX value comes from a search excerpt of the RBA overview page dated 15 October 2026; I did not open the page, and I could not confirm a 16 October RBA observation.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparable city was used. Food and drink were priced from Italian tourist-city evidence, with one aggregator cross-check against Rome. Accommodation reflects general knowledge of Venice's high-season hotel market, which is priced above most other Italian cities.
